scope: Controller sandbox, synthetic isolation gate, onboarding gate and runtime contract. Not a model-written controller or complete pick/place run.
checks: controller modules compile in the same opaque sandbox and must define control(state); driver runtimes cannot run control()
offline reference module reaches every synthetic case (rotation, swap, reversal, nonlinearity, travel limit, mid-run reversal)
isolation gate rejects out-of-range, throwing, NaN, always-verify and fixed-mapping controllers
onboarding: a failing controller keeps start_control closed with no actuation; provenance labels offline reference and synthesized code
a controller output that violates the contract at run time stops the episode without sending that action
